name: Shadow Whispers
text:
**Shadow Whispers** (religion trait; Norgorber)

You have a penchant for just knowing others’ secrets. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (local) checks and a +2 trait bonus on Intimidate checks made to demoralize opponents.
